title: Three words
summary: Three questions, each offering four words, and the sheet asks which one is preferred rather than which one is correct. It exists to be the pair of the other experience: it needs only paper, so a house with a printer and a scanner and no display runs the whole of it, and the two steps that speak on a screen are simply skipped there.
author: written by hand, 19 August 2026

sheet.title: Tre parole
sheet.instructions: Scegli quella che preferisci. Non ce n'è una giusta.

questions.text: Quale parola ti piace di più?
